# Mariposa Mobile Phlebotomy

> Certified mobile phlebotomy (in-home blood draws) across Sonoma, Marin, Napa, Solano, Sacramento, and the greater San Francisco Bay Area. Booked online, done at your door. Compassionate care, delivered to you.

## Key facts
- Founder / lead phlebotomist: Ellie (Arely Arango Ramos), California CPT-1 certified (License #CPT-02356928), ER background
- Phone / text: (707) 280-3651
- Booking: https://mariposamobilephlebotomy.as.me
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 3pm, Saturday 8am to 11am
- Based in Rohnert Park, CA 94928 (6020 Kerry Road) — this is a mobile service dispatch base, not a walk-in location; phlebotomists travel to the client
- HIPAA compliant, fully insured
- Same-day and next-day availability
- Autism-informed, sensory-aware care available

## Services
- Home blood draws (in-home, starting at $200)
- Workplace & office draws (on-site for teams and wellness programs)
- Specialty & functional labs (Genova, Boston Heart, Galleri)
- Care facility & assisted living draws
- Pediatric and athlete performance draws

## Pricing (shown before you book, no hidden fees)
- Standard draw: $200
- Pediatric draw: $200 to $250
- Autism-informed add-on: +$25
- Athlete performance packages: $450 to $700
- Superbills provided for out-of-network insurance reimbursement

## Service area
Sonoma, Marin, Napa, Solano, and Sacramento counties, plus the greater San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, San Mateo).

## Reviews
Clients consistently describe the phlebotomists (Ellie and Lila) as prompt, gentle, professional, and great with children. Read more on the Google Business Profile: search "Mariposa Mobile Phlebotomy Rohnert Park".
